review_text: I wore this dress for engagement photos, and it was almost perfect. The movement of the skirt was amazing, and it was mostly really flattering. I was slightly uncomfortable in the bodice, which technically fit, but was still a little too big on me. I didn't wear a bra, but maybe that would have helped.I think the straps are just a little too long and kept slipping. The leather is definitely luxurious, and I had a great time wearing it.

Rented for a family holiday party, and this was great for that. Not a statement dress, but beautiful. I'm usually a 2 or 4 in dresses, and am glad I got the 6 in this - it fit perfectly. The cut of this dress is very flattering, and the fabric is a dream. The lined back panel means you can wear a standard bra, and the delicate lace means you only need simple jewelry - so easy to look good in this dress!

1) If you have a bust, this top is not for you. The cut just wasn't made for bustier ladies. It's too short, too tight in the chest, very unflattering. 2) The ruffles on the sleeves are way too big. On the RTR photos it looks interesting; in person it looks circus-y.

review_summary: I loved this dress--fancy but comfortable.
review_text: I wore the back-up size 6. I could have worn the 4, but it was much tighter around my waist, and I wanted to be comfortable. The 6 was slightly big on top, but so was the 4, so I decided to go with the 6. I wore double-sided fashion tape under the shoulder straps just in case, but it was fine. I was able to wear a bra--it had normal shoulder straps, but it is a low-back bra. The skirt in front came to my knees, and was longer in the back. The dress was very comfortable all night; I didn't have any issues with the sequins and my arms. It looked great on--very sparkly. I was sad to pack it up and send it back.

I couldn't wear this top because the sleeves were too tight on me.  The body was loose and flowy.  This top won't work well for anyone with arms that aren't stick thin. The fabric was really pretty, but there was also a red stain on the front of mine so I wouldn't have been able to wear it anyway.

review_summary: This is the most comfortable dress ever!
review_text: It does run small...so size up of you have a butt :). Also.....no spanx needed

review_summary: Cute dress but too short for work.
review_text: I liked the dress but it was a bit tight in the chest and shoulders and I am not busty or broad. It was nice material but on the verge of too short for a conservative work environment.

This dress even more beautiful than the pictures give it credit for!  It was the perfect length and the lace on the side of the dress and the sleeves and neckline add a little bit of drama without being over the top.  Material has a slight stretch so not constricting.  I am more of an hourglass shape so i could size down from my normal 8 to a size 6 for this because the hip fit was not an issue but the top was perfect.  I kept saying all night i wish i could buy this dress! I will most certainly consider renting it again.

I thought this looked so cute in the photos, I was wrong. This dress was more like a tunic on me. I am 5'7 and it was mini. It also has a border of lace running through a strange spot around the hip area. I wish it fit me better, or next time I would size up.

review_summary: Wore for my birthday at casino
review_text: This size was very odd in my opinion. It is BEAUTIFUL. Details, color, material, but the corset-like top was a bit snug (and I have a very small chest), however, it wasn't uncomfortable. I am 5'10 and was worry about length, so I ordered a medium and back up large. I didn't even touch the large, the medium was a good fit though it was baggy in my hip/stomach area. I would have been better off ordering the small, but then I fear the top would have been too tight. It is a strange fit. Unfortunately I don't think the S, M, L sizing for this style works. I would have been between a S/M. However, I did love the dress. Tons of compliments, you will look great!
really pretty and great pattern. A bit tight if you have a large chest.

review_summary: Great dress, but runs smaller than expected.
review_text: The fit was strange, the top was tight, and the boning in it made the sides sort of stick out.  I didn't need to wear any spanx underneath which was nice, but I expected the dress to be a little looser for a size 6.  Hard to zip the back without help.  For what I needed it for, it did the job!

review_summary: Very lovely, elegant but runs small
review_text: Loved the dress, the slit is a bit higher than I anticipated.  The dress runs small and with a waistband just at the ribcage, could've ordered an 8 for some more room.  The 6 *just* fit...

Love this dress! The color is beautiful and I loved the thick material. I did not wear spanx, but you certainly could to smooth things out. I typically wear a 0-2, and wound up wearing the 6 in this dress so that I could eat and dance without having to suck in!

review_summary: Loved the dress. It was perfect for my son's baptism in November.
review_text: The dress fits small. I usually wear a 0 or a 2 and I had to order and wear a 4.  Rent the Runway's wonderful customer service was able to send me a 4 in time for my sons baptism.  It is also on the shorter side.  If you are 5'2 or under this dress is perfect.

I wore this to my best friend's wedding.  I am also a professional wedding photographer, so I half attended and half worked this wedding.  Of course I wanted to take my best friend's wedding pics, but I also wanted to enjoy the wedding as a guest too... I typically wear dress pants and a dressy top to weddings, but I really wanted to wear a dress.  This dress was the perfect dress!  I ordered a 4 and a 6.  If I was only attending, I would have worn the 4 (it fit like a glove!) but since I was working I wore the 6, it had a tad more give.  There wasn't really a huge size difference, so def size up ladies!  I got SO many compliments on the dress.  I felt professional, beautiful, and dressed up enough to fit right in with the rest of the guests once I was done shooting.
couldn't wear, too small. so cute though. not good if you have a large bust.

SO MANY COMPLIMENTS. Very low cut, wore a shaw for the wedding then took it off for the reception. Wore a stick on bra which made sure there weren't any mishaps while dancing.  Perfect length for shorter women. The zipper did take a very long time and 3 of us to zip.

I've noticed some Elizabeth & James pieces are quite true to size and others are almost shockingly small.  This was the latter - I got in on with no real problem, but even being in shape enough to confidently rock a crop top, there was a little too much skin poking out the sides of this for me to be comfortable wearing it publicly.  It needs a little more stretch - would size up.  I'm generally between a 4-6, at least in my waist, and the 6 was borderline at best.

review_summary: Cute casual dress but not great on curves
review_text: Lower half of dress much slimmer than anticipated; very snug in hips causing it ride up and liner to show.

review_summary: This dress is a classic, flattering cut and the color is AMAZING.
review_text:
Worn for a rustic outdoor wedding and barn reception. I'm all about a good statement necklace and this dress is perfect for it! I received so many compliments on this dress, I loved wearing it, it made me feel amazing. I would wear this dress again in a heartbeat (good thing you can also rent this exact dress in a lovely fuchsia color!). It does run VERY small. I normally wear a 4, maybe 6. I ended up wearing the 6, but it was a little snug, I'm sure the 8 would've been perfect. 

Do yourself a favor, rent this dress, you WON'T regret it!

review_summary: Adorable pleats and a flattering cut all around
review_text: Usually a size 10 but 12 fit perfect. Perfect dress really. And I would totally buy it once I'm down to goal weight.

review_summary: Wanted Carrie Bradshaw Goes to the Office, got Bridesmaid Recycling Dress
review_text: I thought I could wear this with a cardigan and some lowtop white Converse for a low key Friday office outfit. Ummmm NO. The material is crepey and looks like a straight up bridesmaid dress from J.Crew. Also the bodice is rather long so it didn't hit at my natural waist, it kept going to the uppermost part of the hips (and I'm 5'9.5"). Finally, I have rented two other Adeam dresses in size 2 for a perfect fit, but my 32DDD bust could BARELY fit into the top, and in fact by the end of the day I had red pressure marks inside from how tight it pressed on my strapless bra. I still gave it 3 stars, because it really would be a great bridesmaid dress for a very tall, smaller busted woman. But that's it.

I went to a black tie wedding in a barn, so I wanted something that was black tie, but not too formal. The dress is made of a thicker fabric than I imagined, but gives good structure, so no bra necessary. Tighter in the rib cage and looser in the straps, almost off the shoulder at certain parts of the night. I'm 5'2" and wore 4 inch heels and the dress was a good length for me. Beware the lace; sometimes my heels would snag the lace and I almost tripped, so be careful or wear a thicker heel.

review_summary: Wore this to my bachelorette party in Las Vegas
review_text: I am in between a size 6 and an 8 (6 on top, 8 on the bottom). I went with a size 8 because the reviews said it ran small and I'm happy I did! This was so tight, I never would have fit into the 6. I wore spanx which worked out well because white is an unforgiving color. If you are self-conscious about your mid section this might not be the best dress for you (unless you rely heavily on spanx like I do!) I did not need to wear a bra with this. Overall very happy with how it worked out. The only downside is that the color was a little "dingy"- you could tell it had been worn and washed multiple times.

review_summary: Too small, couldn't wear either size.
review_text: Beautiful dress, stretchy and comfortable. Unfortunately, as other reviewers have noted, it's small. It was almost too short for me as well. I could get it on but it was too "sexy" for the event and my age because it was tight, so I went to a backup. Had I worn it, it would have looked fine with a strapless bra or even without a bra (presuming sufficient warmth). For most of us it probably requires some shapewear as it's fabric reveals all.

review_summary: I received a lot of compliments and felt very good in the dress all days at work.
review_text:
The fit is okay- I chose size 8, but usually wear a size 6. 
The armhole is a bit too high/tight, the neckline is also very close to the neck. I really wish this had a longer zipper at CB to step into the dress, especially since it is white- getting it on and off over my head was not easy.
This dress needed a lot of steaming when it arrived, and also wrinkled easily throughout the day.
The sleeve was a bit too short for me- I'm 5'9", but I still rocked it.

I really loved both the color and the style of this dress. The fabric was thick and excellent quality. The length was classy but the fitted top and ruffled slit made me feel sexy. I usually wear a 4 or 6 and ended up wearing a 6. I would definitely recommend this dress!

review_summary: Had to return next day. Sleeves were too small.
review_text: I tried this in a large. Though I usually take an extra large to account for shirts underneath. Even without a shirt on I couldn't get my arm in over the past the elbow. My upper arms aren't my best feature. If you are toned or skinny there you would probably be OK.

review_summary: My favorite rental yet!! Received tons of compliments!!
review_text: The gown is amazing! It runs on the smaller side... I wear a 2 and this was the 40 regular. The back is what makes the gown! The material is thick so even though it is very fitted you couldn't see any lumps or bumps through the fabric! I was comfortable all night! The length worked well for me too... I had on a wedge type formal shoe. I would definitely rent this gown again!! I wish I owned it! I was sad to have to send it back! It's business in the front and party/fun in the back!!
The midsection is tight so I sized up but this dress is dreamy and so regal

review_summary: Lovely color, flattering fit, fun ruffle
review_text: This was a really fun dress to rent, and I got it for a great price.  The fit was flattering, the ruffle was a lot of fun, and the color was perfect for the fall wedding I attended.  I'm 5'3 and the length was comfortable for dancing in.  I was hoping to be able to wear a normal bra, but the way the front cuts in the straps showed, so I went with a strapless bra.  I'm 125 lb, 34C and normally wear a size 4, but the 6 was more comfortable in the chest and underarm area and fit pretty much the same everywhere else, so I'd recommend sizing up as a backup.

review_summary: Classic and sexy at the same time...
review_text: I'm usually a 6 but that one fitted a little too snug on the hips. I'm 5'3 and it was kind of short when I raised my arms so a taller person might have an issue there. But it is a beautiful dress that made me feel classic and sexy at the same time ;)

Fit well. Had to size up because of tightness in the chest area. The asymmetrical hem was a lot of fun. Someone said it was like the dancing woman emoji. Was good for my semi-formal event and was more fun then a stand LBD. Can also wear with a normal bra which was a plus. Very flattering and I received a couple compliments. If you are worried about it being tight order a larger extra size.
Fit like a glove. Fabric has no give. I am 5'6" and 125 lbs.  Simple.  Gorgeous color. Super-flattering on.

I really loved the print, cut, and sleeves of the dress, but it definitely runs small. I didn't feel like I would enjoy myself wearing it to dinner, so I ended up not wearing this dress at all, unfortunately. I normally fit into a 0 or XS and I could have definitely sized up.

review_summary: More fun than your average LBD!
review_text: Loved this dress and got  a ton of compliments.  I sized up because of the only thing I didn't like--the pockets are lined in nude fabric- in a smaller size, they gaped a little and I didn't like the look from the side/rear.  This would be great for a ton of diff occasions.

I absolutely love the cut of this dress!  It is so flattering on!  My usual dress size is a four and I’m wearing a 42 ( size 6) in the photo.  The dress ran a little  small so I recommend going a size up for your backup size.  The dress was fitted all through my midsection and loose at my hips because the dress flares out.  The fabric has no stretch.  The dress would work best for an A to C cup.  I am a 34D and it was very tight on me.  The dress should be worn with a strapless bra.  I am 5’9” and the dress was mid-thigh to knee length on me.  This dress is perfect for any formal occasion.  Pair with black heels and silver jewelry.

Got many compliments on this dress at the wedding. The only con is the zipper is really hard to get up due to the fabric. The dress did feel a little snug in the ribs. Would love to have this dress as my own!
amazing dress and great fabric. runs small, so please size up. The top tends to flap over a little but nothing fashion tape cant fix.

Sexy, sexy. This top is adorable and I would have worn for a date or a night out. It does run small, so I recommend sizing up, especially if you have larger busts. The fabric has some stretch and works best for A-C cups. You'll definitely have to wear a NuBra or no bra with the way the top is styled with cutouts.

I loved this dress, I felt so sexy in it. The only reason I gave four stars instead of five was that the top part did this weird nipply thing at the folds. But with a steamer I was able to make it less noticeable. I wore a bra with this and was able to tuck it up at the cutouts so it wasn't noticable.

review_summary: Never wore the dress because it didn't zip!
review_text: I consistently wear a zero but this dress wouldn't zip around my ribcage/waist! Sadly, I had to return it without wearing it.

review_summary: Classy and Elegant Dress! Perfect for any occasion!
review_text:
I got so many compliments and loved how I looked. Material felt and looked luxurious. Fit like a dream.   
Only issue, my dress was VERY hard to zip up, had to have 2 friends help me zip it but I do have a larger chest and wide rib cage so I don't 100% blame the dress. Be generous when ordering, I say go up a size or two. Side note, You will need a backless bra if you want to wear one with this, my normal bra kept trying to peek out. Over all, loved it!  

** I'm 5'5, 145lbs and a 34 DD

review_summary: too small to wear so shipped back - I would get 1 or 2 sizes larger.
review_text: Feels great (soft and warm) but too small to wear... :(

PROS:  Stunning, feminine, floral print shift dress. The dress was very comfortable to wear at work and then out for dinner that night. Fabric felt very luxurious next to my skin. Very well made and had an invisible zipper in the back. You can dress it up with a pair of nice heels or down with more casual sandals. This dress was fun to wear and I received lots of compliments. 

CONS:  Italian sizing, ran slightly on the small side. Be sure to size up. It did wrinkle easily from sitting.

Rental Condition:  Excellent
Fabric:  97% Viscose, 3% Elastane
Comfort: Very Comfortable
Season(s): Summer, Late Spring
Special Undergarments Required:  Standard Bra
Surprises:  Ran a little on the short side.

Would I rent it again? Yes.

Measurements Lying Flat
Bust: 17"
Waist: 17"
Hips: 18"
Length: 33"
This is a show stopper! I received compliments the entire night from both men and women. I would definitely rent again. Size up this runs small.

Great dress with beautiful cut. Be prepared to stand out; this is not a dress for wallflowers. It definitely runs small so order a size up. Also, because it was form fitting walking anywhere took extra time :) Would definitely rent it again.

review_summary: The Perfect dress for a Black Tie affair! Don't hesitate... rent this!
review_text: This was my first experience with RTR and it worked out perfectly! I usually would order a Medium as my first size and Large as my backup but the medium was unavailable. I ordered a L with XL as backup but I didn't even try on the XL.. the L fit perfect. I'm sure the M would have worked too but the L was snug and hugged all my curves so I'm glad I went that route. I was also able to wear spanx underneath the dress and that worked out great. I'm a 36C and ended up going sans-bra which worked great... The dress was tight enough to hold everything in place and thick enough were I didn't have to worry about getting cold. I wore this for a New Years Eve, Black Tie Optional wedding and I fit right in. It's definitely an attention grabber so if you don't like the attention maybe steer clear. I would be hesitant to wear this dress to a more casual wedding as it is quite fancy. If you are in doubt, go for it!! You won't regret it! Thanks RTR for a great first experience!

I wore this dress for a black tie optional event. It fit like a glove and was very comfortable to wear all night long! I wore a strapless bra and it looked great. I felt great in this dress and definitely recommend.

I ended up not wearing this dress. It was my first choice, and I'm so glad my second choice option was a different dress. In sum, this dress didn't meet my expectations. The bust area of the dress was too narrow for me, and I would have had to use a good deal of tape to limit side-boob action. The draped fabric in the front made me look frumpy, for lack of a better word. And while the bottom of the dress fit just fin, the bottom stop/retaining box for the zipper was lower than expected and protruded so much that I looked like I had a tail. Maybe great for some, but it definitely doesn't get my recommendation.

review_summary: Pretty plain and simple.  Well made but no wow factor
review_text: Pretty but stiff fabric.  Relatively uncomfortable. But conservative if you have a work event.

review_summary: This was a spectacular wedding in Miami, FL. Fireworks and the whole shabang!
review_text:
I loved this dress, fit like a glove...but maybe I should have rented a larger glove, it's a close call.
I am usually a size 0-2, depending on the brand. I tried on the 2L, as I am 5"8 and almost wish it would have been an Xtra long, I wore 2 inch heels and as you can see in the picture my shoes still showed a little. I prefer my dresses to hit the floor. The dress was TIGHT, and I am very slim...not sure if the 4L would have been to big because I rented a 0L instead, but this was my first time renting from the site.
The service was AMAZING! Literally, delivery on time, return is so simple and easy, I love it and will definitely rent again and again. Thank you!

review_summary: Unique texture, great spring colors! No stretch, well lined. Comfortable but fitted well.
review_text: Good fit but a touch snug even in my larger size so I would suggest sizing up in your backup. I'm not a large person but the 10 was just a hint snug but very flattering. Wore to a "tea" baby shower and got tons of compliments! I loved the vibrant colors, unique texture, and great fit that disguised my 8 month post baby body into a very trim look! I do work out, but it takes time to get your body back, and this dress was very flattering!

review_summary: I can humbly say that I looked amazing this dress! I received so many compliments!
review_text: For curvy ladies like me this dress runs small! I barely got it over my butt and when I sat down it almost hurt to breathe. The size 8 probably would’ve been more comfortable, but I LOVED how the size 6 accentuated my curves.  Since the dress has sleeves I didn’t get any scratches from the material, but it can get caught on things (I almost snatched a girl’s wig off because her hair got stuck on my sequins!) The dress had a solid weight to it and unlike some others I was able to dance all night in it (no dropping it low, though!)

This dress runs extremely small. I typically can wear a two and six fit me. It is super fitted, well constructed a beautiful color. I actually did not end up wearing it to the wedding however as it was 95° and the stress was much too thick and hot to wear to something like that.

review_summary: Gorgeous dress but a little short!
review_text: A little short for someone 5'9 wearing heels. Would have preferred to have some extra length. Typically wear a 14 but it was a bit tight in the hips so I wore the 16.

This dress was lovely and everyone else thought so too.  It was super high quality and very comfortable.  You will need a strapless bra.  The chest ran tight and I needed to size up to the 6.  The 4 fit perfectly everywhere else.  Highly recommend!

review_summary: Perfect dress for a NYE wedding!
review_text: Luxurious, stretchy, thick material. Sequins did not rub at the edges which made it very comfortable. Fit like a glove. Tighter and a lot shorter than expected so wore it with black sheers.
A bit short waisted.

review_summary: Wore this to a meeting in Nashville.
review_text: So, this runs quite small...especially through the torso.  Arm length is fine, and I wore the jacket open.  Could not have buttoned it.

review_summary: This was perfect for an outdoor evening wedding.
review_text: Loved this dress! I ended up wearing my backup size because it was tight in the bust. The fabric is thick, so even though it’s very fitted it is flattering. Highly recommend!

review_summary: Too short for tall girls, but very cute!
review_text: I'm 5'9 with a normal torso and it was too short to wear. If you're shorter than 5'8 I'd say you'd be perfectly fine wearing this. Fit is normal just isn't a romper that works for taller girls.

review_summary: Fit great and received compliments even from the wedding party
review_text: I've had great success with RTR by reading reviews very carefully. Reviews on this dress were spot on - it runs smaller than others I've ordered. I wore a size 2 when I typically wear dress size 0. I didn't need to go all the way up to the size 4, however. The dress was short and perfect for me at 5'1''.
Simple black dress. Wore it for my bachelorette party. Dress rises up from time to time but it worked well to party the night away.

review_summary: So many complements on this dress!
review_text: Dress does run a tad small, but the XL was a perfect fit.  There is no give!  I was able to wear a nude, low cut, racer back bra with the dress without it showing.  The V is deep, so I was worried about what I'd wear underneath!  The color is gorgeous!  I received a ton of complements on the dress!

I listened to reviews and ordered a size up.  The material on the sleeves was tight, so not a dancing dress, but I wore to a cocktail party and had no issues.  The dress is really cute and fun, loved the bell sleeves.  It was very short.  I would have liked one or two more inches, but I really liked the dress overall.  Would rent it again.

review_summary: Gorgeous dress, got compliments all night long!
review_text: Simple elegance. Fit was so flattering! Loved it. Opening in the back is just enough of a touch of "sexy" without sacrificing modesty or being too over the top. You know how you want to find that fine line of looking bomb.com at a wedding without being distracting/taking away from the beautiful bride?! This totally fits that bill. Wish I could have kept it. Dress DEFINITELY runs small, glad I went a size up.

review_summary: I normally wear an XS/0/2 and i ordered this shirt in an XS and could not nearly button it
review_text: Beautiful shirt with nice structure.  Made for girls with tiny wastes.  I have a more square build but normally have no issues fitting in an XS.
I received compliments everywhere I went.  The dress was actually really comfortable.  The zipper was hard to get up and down on the medium dress.  The small fit me but was very short.
I'm a true size 2 and the dress fit beautifully but there's no room around the waist. I'd recommend the size 4 if you want to feel more comfortable throughout the night.

Rented this for a wedding but didn't end up wearing it :( The dress was way too tight on me and the material was very thin and made me feel like everything was showing. Perhaps it'd be better for someone less curvy.

The sleeves are so cute on this top. It's thicker material-almost sweater like. It's cropped and runs a smidge small. The small was fine with high-waisted jeans (not too much tummy peaking out). The style is really flattering and would be great on a shorter girl.

review_summary: I wore the dress to a dinner party for work, the event was in Mexico.
review_text: I loves the dress and did go one size larger to a 12. I am 5'7 with 34c bust, 155 lbs.

review_summary: I wore this for a baby shower in February.
review_text: I ordered the M and S and ended up with the S. They were both tight through my ribcage, but the small was a little more flattering at the bottom. It arrived late Friday night, which did not give me much time to try it on and feel good about it. Once I was there, it was a nice fit with black tights and heels.
It was so cute, but it was too short in the torso. I'm 5'6 and couldn't comfortably wear it. I went up a size due to other reviews and it wasn't enough.
I ordered the size I usually wear in this brand, but there was a gaping hole in my chest when I buttoned it up.

review_summary: Perfect dress for a hot, summer wedding!
review_text: I loved the give of the dress around mid section. I felt very comfortable all night eating dinner and dancing. The top added some unique appeal too but was secure and comfortable. I would rent again!

I absolutely adore this dress. I had to size up to get the top to fit properly since there's absolutely no give in the zipper, but once I had the right size, it was perfect. It's beautiful and flowy, the colors are stunning and it made me feel like a queen. I wore it to a fancy dinner and it was perfect. At 5'7", the regular was the perfect length on me, and I wore 3" heels. I'd only go with the long if you're over 5'10" or plan to wear VERY high shoes.

I LOVED the idea of this piece, but it was terribly ill fitting on me. I'm 5'1" so I figured the pant length might be a problem -- it was. The pant hem hit right above my ankles, which was a bit awkward, but I totally could have made it work with hem tape. The real bummer was the torso length. The crotch hung down a good 8 inches lower than it should have. And yes, as others have mentioned, the bust/ribcage area runs small. I WISH you had this in petite!!!

review_summary: It was incredibly tight in the butt, but the fabric is so beautiful.
review_text: I had been wanting to try this dress for a while and once I got the unlimited membership, it was the first thing I put on my list. The fabric is gorgeous and the upper body fit true to size. However, the butt was incredibly tight. If I was standing still, this was the perfect size. However, when I tried to walk, the skirt would really ride up (and not in a fun, sexy way) due to the tightness. Since I do currently have unlimited, I'm going to try this dress again but get a size 8 instead.

I ordered a small which I'm usually between an XS & a S so I usually size up. The fabric on this doesn't allow for a lot of wiggle room and I was uncomfortable with how tight the fit was! It looked cute but I couldn't wear it!

awesome dress!! not only is the pattern great, it is extremely figure flattering and floats behind you as you walk. the shoulder details are great, too. i'm typically a 4 and the 4 in this dress fit fine, although i would've preferred a 6 since i have a large waist and there is no stretch. it's a button on the inner wrap and a snap button on the outer wrap so size up if you're not sure since the tie around the waist will cinch the dress anyway. i'm only 5'3" so the longest part of the dress almost hit the ground. i highly highly recommend this dress!!

I got compliments on my dress the day of the wedding and afterwards from posting the picture. There is no way to wear a bra with this dress. You could probably try to wear stick on cups or pasties, but I chose to be braless. I felt fine. :)
The dress was great to dance with, but at the end of the night when it was time to take it off - the zipper got stuck! It was a pain to take off because I was afraid the zipper would break! You definitely need a second pair of hands to zip the dress on/off. I am not a fan of dresses with a side zipper, as I feel that it makes the dress tighter.  That is why I wore the 6, not the 4.

review_summary: Beautiful Print but Tight On Top!
review_text: I wore this dress for a friend's wedding and this was my first experience with RTR. I reviewed pictures from other women who had worn the dress who had similar body type/weight/height to me and found that they opted for larger dresses. With that in mind, I decided to order the 8 with a 10 as a back up instead of my normal 6 and I'm glad I did. The 10 was more comfortable because it was looser around the ribs and bust, but it wasn't as flattering as the 8 was on me, so I dealt with the tightness and wore the 8. The material on the dress was so silky and the pictures do not do it justice with regards to the pattern. Something to note: the flowers at the bottom were not a true gold, so it was a little more difficult finding jewelry to match than I'd originally expected. If you are large chested and/or have a larger rib cage, definitely consider sizing up. Length-wise, this hit perfectly at the knee on me.
Amazing dress. Do size up, but it will fit like a glove!, I loved the shape it gave and that it hugged in the right areas, but was still very classic. The color is so pretty in person!

review_summary: Wore this for my engagement party. Was fun and trendy, but still classic. Got compliments all night.
review_text: Fabric is very flattering. It is a thick, stretchy, neoprene-like material. It was not tight but skimmed the body perfectly. Fabric was not sheer - very opaque.
I wore this on a nice Thanksgiving dinner.  It is stiffer in the top as people said.  The pockets are great.  The color is bright and I wore it with a strapless bra.
I am normally a solid M, even sometimes a S in Herve... this one i couldn't zip.  not sure if it was the one I received or what.  The color was fabulous, so it was a shame.
Beautiful color, excellent material quality. Unfortunately it runs very small, so I couldn't wear it.

review_summary: I wore this for my rehearsal dinner and loved it! I received many compliments and felt so pretty!
review_text: I found this runs a little small, I am usually a 6 in Lilly and sometimes a 4. I rented the 6 and the 8 and the 6 was way too small with the 8 being just right.

review_summary: OMG, this dress is fabulous!!!  I wore it to 3 different events in 4 days!
review_text: This is one of the highest quality, highest style outfits I have ever worn!  Its very form-fitting, which made me happy I had requested a medium as the backup, because usually I'm a small.  The lines are just beautiful.  If the retail price wasn't so high I would try to find it and buy it, very very special!!!

This dress is like wearing a straight jacket. It runs small and is quite short. I ended up not wearing it for my event because I couldn't move my arms. Pretty color and texture but completely impractical (unless you just want to stand still all night).

This dress is beautiful.  The material is luxurious and the details are really special.  Unfortunately, I could not wear it because the chest just wouldn't lay right because I am very busty.  It is also very small through the waist with no give so although it zipped all the way up without a problem, it would have been uncomfortable.  The next size up would be too big in the body.

review_summary: Love the dress, received many compliments.
review_text: The dress does run small, I am 5ft 6 inches weigh 130 and I wore a size small, the med fit also but the chest area on the med was too big. The dress is very well made, the bedding detail looks better in person than in the picture.

I wore this dress for a Derby Party. I really liked the stripes on the dress because it reminded me of candy canes so I had red and white mints that I hot glued to my hat! It was super fun and I got a lot of compliments!
PROS
-super cute dress
-nice pattern
CONS
-runs small, I'd def size up
-I'd suggest spanx

review_summary: Great colors - so unique. Would rent again.
review_text: Runs really small - keep in mind UK sizes and then go 1 or 2 sizes up from there! It was a little tight on my arms but overall just hugged my curves well.

review_summary: Great fabric, great for a party with southwest or desert theme
review_text: The dress catches at the hip a little bit it needs just a little bit in a weird way. Needs more of an A-line flair
Runs small

review_summary: Warm, charming, not good for busty girls
review_text: The fit was just not flattering.  I think it may be the "bib" on the top, which doesn't seem very bulky in photos, but it actually was.

To begin, this dress is beautiful on. Sometimes you see the model's picture and know, it will never look like that on me. I thought that about this dress, but it fits beautifully. Fit on the top & flair on the bottom. The front cut out is very flattering if you have at least some boobage - my size is equiv to 32D (30DD). The cut out deep plunge did not cut into or smush my cleavage - really enhanced it. I usually don't like exposing my chest that much but this dress is flattering. It's a spring/summer looking dress though the fabric is a bit heavier than you might expect - not thick, it moves and breathes with you. No stretch and yet not stiff. The pale pink is so flattering. Fun for a party - you will definitely stand out amid the crowd!

review_summary: I wore it for drinks with friends.
review_text: The shirt is nice.  I wore it out to drinks with friends.  No stretch to the material.  I move tot much at work to wear it there.  Maybe a larger size would be more comfortable but then it would be too large.
Really great work dress.  The dress fit true to size.  Would rent again!

review_summary: Finally a floor-length dress that works!
review_text: This dress was perfect–the length was exactly what I needed, I'm 5'2", 130 lbs, and wore 2.5 inch heels and the skirt was just enough off the ground that I never got it caught in my heels. My only 2 complaints are the zipper was really difficult to zip up or down–I never would have been able to get the dress on without help. This also made me think I needed the 8P when the 6P is what actually ended up fitting, so make sure to try both sizes before getting discouraged by a tough zipper! Also the arms holes could be slightly bigger–I felt fine for most of the evening, but by the end of the night I realized the side of the arm hole closest to my chest had started to irritate my arms.

I wore this for my office holiday party. Overall, I loved it and it got a ton of compliments! I normally wear a 0 or a 2, and the 2 was just a little baggy in a couple places. The dress is tight and not the most comfortable (dancing would be tough) and you can't lift your arms very well, but the fit is great and the length is perfect for a work event (for someone who is 5'2" like me), and you can wear a regular strapless bra with no issues.

review_summary: Comfortable dress, fit like a glove
review_text: Super comfortable dress, easy to move around in. Wouldn't recommend it in the summer time as the fabric is fairly thick so you will get hot, especially for anything outdoors. I would have loved 1 or 2 more inches on the length but it was fine with ~3 inch heels. There is a slit in the back which is hard to see in the pictures

review_summary: This paired really well with a Joie cream top!  Lots of compliments!
review_text: These are high waisted and fit like a glove! I would definitely rent these again....Very  tempting to purchase! This is my first time wearing See by Chloe and I loved them.

review_summary: Pretty pattern, but not as pretty on
review_text: Gorgeous fabric and beautiful neckline, however–it flattened me out on top and how the gathers were around the waist made it look bigger somehow. Wish it would have looked better. Guess it just doesn't work on my body.

I rented this beautiful dress for my medical school graduation. I was horrified to see it arrive in the condition in the above images. I'm a loyal RTR customer and have never had issues with cleaning/quality, but the neckline of this white dress was entirely brown and frayed. I was unable to wear my usual size and had to wear the alternate size (which did not fit me properly, since it was too large). So disappointed in the quality of RTR cleaning. Will never rent a white dress from RTR again.
So flirty and the color is beautiful.

It is a beautiful and well made dress. I do not think it is the best option for someone with wider hips, as I have. Flattering fit for mid section but does not hide the hips well. I usually wear a size 8 dress but the 10 in this dress fit better. It must be a popular dress because another lady at my event was wearing it too!

review_summary: As the mother of the bride, I wanted something special and this fit the bill!  Fantastic dress !
review_text: Ordered the 4 and 6. The 4 was probably the better fit but I ended up wearing the 6 because it was more comfortable for sitting, moving, dancing etc. I wore a strapless bra, which helped fill in a bit. Gorgeous color. Lots of compliments. Not too short nor too long and that cape added some flair you don't see in most dresses.
Fun dress! Fit really well (may even run slightly large) and was very flattering. Skirt is short and good for twirling!

review_summary: Love that it is girly AND goth!
review_text: This is super-easy to wear and the print is gorgeous. It fits loosely and the sleeves add a cool updated vibe. I liked it a lot and wore it three times!

review_summary: Great for a weekend social function
review_text: This dress is so comfy and looks incredible. The length was great with flats and the high-low hem added interest to the overall silhouette. Would definitely rent again.

I wore this to a Tropicana themed event and it was perfect. I got a ton of compliments. The off the shoulder stayed up and in place easily all night. The pockets were a bit bunchy at times but didn't bother me much. I would definitely recommend.

review_summary: Loved that it had pockets. I received many comments!
review_text:
I have an athletic build and the flared skirt gave me the "hips" I don't have!!
It was a little weird when my arms we at my side. I could feel the "roughness" of the heavy sequins attached.
..

review_summary: Cute & flattering jumpsuit that's easy to wear.
review_text: If you are in between sizes I would recommend sizing down. I am 5'7 1/2 and 123lbs. I ordered a 4 and probably could have fit into a 2. It's boxier around the hips. Can easily wear a strapless bra and the jumpsuit doesn't fall off. The one I rented was in pretty good shape, although one side of the clasp at the top of the zipper was missing it still stayed in place.

review_summary: When dress walked in the room all heads were on me.Stunning comfortable to dance in. Adult PromQueen
review_text: Perfect fit for my daughter 5'6" 36A

review_summary: In LOVE with this Spring affair!
review_text: Felt like a princess in this dress. Received compliments all night. Even had random strangers come up to me just to tell me how much they loved this dress. Perfect fit. Gorgeous design and great material. Pockets for the win!!! Just the right amount of skin on the back and super darling in the front.

review_summary: It was very comfortable for work.
review_text: The dress fits great. The material sucks you in and is very flattering. I wish it came in every color.

review_summary: Absolutely loved this dress....so many compliments the entire night!
review_text: So the fit of the dress was great and it was rather comfortable...my only cons with the dress were that it was kinda short at the bottom and I'm a short chick, I'm only 5'3".....and the sequins ended up irritating the inside of my nails...I think from me grabbing at it when I was dancing....but I loved it! Perfect for a gala event!
Beautiful dress, definitely buying this one. So classic. Runs TTS.
Gorgeous fit, I ordered two sizes (Small and Medium), both were great, could go with either one. Small fit the best.

I wore this dress for a military ball and absolutely loved it! Black is classic, however, the top of the dress gives it a bit more flare. I'm 5'10 and found that the 2L was the perfect length with flats on. There's a little train to it, which is pretty for pictures (but, let's be honest... my date kept stepping on it!). The material does have some stretch to it, thankfully. So, it make the sitting down, standing up, sitting down for the ceremony a little easier. It was hard to send it back! It's such a lovely dress.

review_summary: OMG i loved this dress the color the style the material it was beautiful! the boobs kind of point.
review_text: great dress, the hem the boobs kind of look pointy but I loved it! wore to a wedding rehearsal dinner
I did not wear this because I rented another dress, but this was a strong contender.  The fabric is luscious and the embroidery is exquisite.  Will definitely get this one again.

review_summary: This was a fun dress for work. The pattern POPS and people noticed it.
review_text: I am a curvy gal and I wouldn't say this is the best shape for my figure but this dress is about the mod look and colors. It was perfect for work and comfortable. I am usually a large 8 or small 10 and the 44 worked great.

review_summary: You will feel flirty, confident and sexy in this dress! Its comfortable and true to size!
review_text: The best word I can use to describe this dress is whimsical! I rented this dress for a black tie wedding and it was exactly what I was looking for. It's tight in all the right places and light enough where you don't feel hot or sweaty after dancing the night away. Perfect for an indoor or outdoor Spring/Summer wedding and or event! I wore a 4R and it was the perfect length and fit. The chest is a little open but I have a small bust and didn't find it problematic at all. The only con (minor) I can think of is the straps; they tend to drop, so that is something you will want to be mindful of. This dress is a statement piece. If you are looking to standout I highly recommend this fashion forward dress. I paired it with Oscar De La Renta tassel earrings in silver and nude ankle strap heels (3.75 inches) . If you decide to rent this dress, you will not regret your decision!

This is a cute romper but it runs really big on top. I have a small chest/am pear shaped so this ended up not being the most flattering fit, but I could see it being super flattering on someone with a more hourglass shape or broader shoulders!

review_summary: If you are thinking of renting this dress, DO IT!
review_text: The dress fit very well and it was very flattering. I felt comfortable and confident wearing it. I particularly like how the dress accentuates your best features while slimming problem areas (i.e., stomach). I highly recommend this bold and classy piece!
Fit like a glove.  I just had a baby so the flare was perfect. .the pockets a plus. I ddnt need a necklace bc of the beautiful lace detail.
Excellent fabric - kind of slinky, but still very flattering. The shape is awesome; really accentuated my waist.
Love how versatile this jumper was! You could rock it for summer or winter. It was slightly boxy, which is why i decided to belt it. Fit was true to size. Overall a great rental!

review_summary: This dress was perfect for my daughters masquerade sweet 16.
review_text: I wore this dress with spanx and a 2 1/2 inch heel. The dress is stretchy, the back is a little longer than the front. It's a beautiful shiny gold which I accessorized with gold earrings and one big ring.
I wore this for dressy cocktail parties and just everyday with jeans.  True to size, warm and loved it!

I had wanted to rent this dress for some time now and when it was finally available, I reserved. It was everything I needed it to be for a summer wedding: Comfortable, colorful and classy. I highly recommend as it hugs in the right areas and has a great pattern that is not in your face. So many compliments which makes me want to wear it to every event!

I LOVED this dress for a fall wedding a few weeks ago.  I got the 4 and 6 and could've went with either, but decided on the 6 (though I did wear the 4 slip) just to be a little more comfortable for all the drinks and food that I knew I was going to have at the wedding.

Color is more orange/red 
Nice thick fabric!
Comfortable!
I'm a 34 D/DD and it fit perfect !
I would rent this again!

review_summary: This dress is very RISK-AY! I almost didn't wear it, but glad I did!
review_text: This is for the bold only, I don't suggest wearing it unless you want to make an entrance. That being said, I got a ton of compliments all night and felt great once I got the "girls" in place. I wore stick-on cups because after nursing two kids I felt like I needed to (I also used fabric tape to be sure everything stayed where it should). Those with who are still perky probably not need the stick-ons.  Overall, the dress was comfortable and forgiving and I felt super sexy in it!

review_summary: I wore this for an Oct outside wedding in MD. I received so many compliments and felt stunning in it
review_text: This dress is true to size. I'm 5'3", 140, 34D. It fit like a glove and I was able to wear this dress without a bra and it still felt appropriate and snug (in a good way). The dress is a bit heavy and for me the sleeves were a bit long, but neither of those things bothered me. The dress is even more ornate than the pictures show. I paired it was matte black heals and a black/purple/green sparkly clutch.

The fit was good, although there was a slight pucker in the abdomen.  I wasn't sure if it was intentional, or if I have a shorter torso.  It was true to size.  The color and sequins are gorgeous, although a little scratchy around the neck and arm holes.  Otherwise the dress was comfortable and easy to wear.  I wore with a nubra for a little extra oomph.

review_summary: Fun dress for a summer rehearsal dinner!
review_text: I originally got this dress as a backup because RTR didn't have my backup size available for my first choice dress for a family wedding. Thankfully both dresses fit, and I ended up wearing this one to the rehearsal dinner. The fabric was great quality, and it fit well. Both the 2 and the 4 fit, but I ended up going with the 4 for some extra room around my ribs. I'm not at all busty so I did feel like I was pulling up the front for a lot of the night, but I think that was more because I was self-conscious than the dress having issues. Overall a very fun dress that I received many compliments on!

review_summary: Gorgeous dress! I wore this to a baby shower and received compliments from strangers.
review_text: The fit was similar to other dresses from this designer.

I would have worn this to a gala, but unfortunately it was postponed due to Hurricane Harvey. I tried it on anyways and it would have been perfect. Both sizes fit well, but the Large was more comfortable for me. Just FYI, you can't wear a regular bra since it is low in the back, but the fabric holds on top enough to hold the girls up (for me at least). If I would have worn it to the event, I probably would not have worn any bra.

review_summary: The dress was perfect for a formal charity event.  I felt sexy without overexposing legs or cleavage
review_text: There are no negatives to the dress. The off the shoulder and dramatic sleeve details are stunning. The fabric is very forgiving and slimming.  It is very comfortable and sexy.

review_summary: Wore it to a job interview - got an offer the next day!
review_text: This jacket is awesome!  Super structured and silky with a beautiful floral print.  I paired it with a slimming black turtleneck and black high-waisted skinny jeans for a job interview - and killed it.   Highly recommend !

review_summary: This dress fit great and was perfect for my 21st birthday!
review_text: The dress looked just as pictured. It was very difficult to zip up due to the extra fabric around the band until the bust, but once I got it on (which was a two person process), it was very comfortable. It is also very very lowcut, which I loved. But if mind showing cleavage this is probably not the dress for you! Overall I would highly recommend this dress.

review_summary: Love this dress. Elegant, flattering and easy to wear.
review_text: Great fit, TTS, perfect length

review_summary: This dress is stunning and I got so many compliments even from strangers!
review_text: A bit too long, but otherwise really beautiful.

I have to wear blazers a lot for work and I'm so happy to have found a fun cream colored one for work at RTR!  It's got a nice stretch material in it and the sleeves are great!  I loved the fit and style.  This cuts and fits true to size.  I would rent it again and buy it!

I loved this dress. The A-line cut hid my imperfections and highlighted my strengths. I'm 5'7 1/2 (had to add my half) :) 168 lbs.  Received soooo many compliments and felt sexy.  My only gripe was the slip underneath is soooo short. It stopped literally right under my cheeks. The front is longer than the back. I ordered a 10 and an 8 and the 8 slip was longer than the 10. I was a little self conscious at first then just made sure not to bend over at all. Lol so recommend getting some nude underwear or getting a size up in hopes of it being longer.

Wore it with Ramy Brook's Navy Paris Dress.  It was a great outer layer when walking around in 50 deg weather in the evening.  Just chic enough to fit into the city environment but not too dressy.  I didn't notice any significant shedding but the dress is a synthetic so may not have been susceptible.  I would rent it again.
The dress was beautiful and so flattering! I got compliments all night and felt beautiful. The details are amazing and the back of the dress is stunning. It fits true to size and good length.

I rented this for an event and absolutely loved it! The dress is gorgeous in person. There isn't a lot of give as there typically would be a shift dress due to beading, but it fit true to size. This is a versatile dress that could be worn to weddings, cocktail parties or other more formal events. Such a fun look.

review_summary: This dress was so comfortable and I got a TON of compliments. Loved every minute I wore it!
review_text: The slip underneath the dress was long enough to cover but short enough to let the dress breath - I did not get hot in it. The straps were great in length but the chest/bust was a little looser than I wanted - I wish I wore some sticky boobs of some sort. The dress was also a little longer than I thought - so plan to hold it up for dancing or plan to wear high heels to avoid tripping!

review_summary: Beautiful red wine color.  Beautiful lace trim.
review_text: The fit was perfect for me and the fabric is very soft.  Its a little tight around the hips which makes sitting down a little difficult at times.  The bottom sways so beautifully while you are walking.  Definitely makes me want to own this dress.

I was unsure about this dress bc (1) I thought the length might not work for me (I'm short, 5'2 or so) and its a cleaner, more modern style than I'm used to. However, I was pleased. The material is thick and stretchy and comfortable, the length was good, and it made my back and booty look great. I dont think I'll end up wearing it, because it's a little plain, and a bit large in the bust (I'm 34/36B, ordered a 4 and 6, and am wearing the 4 in these photos - I think the 2 might've been too tight in the hips but who knows). Still, a nice basic, flattering, and classic dress. Runs true to size, maybe even a bit large.
Great color (deep wine red), perfect fit & very comfortable. I would definitely rent again.

review_summary: I got so many compliments on the dress and how beautiful it was.
review_text: The dress fit true to size. The one con about it was the zipper getting stuck in some places. The whole process of returning the dress was very simple and well thought out. I got so many compliments on this dress. I got a size 14R and ended up wearing the back-up 16R I requested due to my belly and breasts. The dress was very comfortable, seeing as I had it on for around 11 hours for a Military Ball. Overall, I would recommend this dress to anyone.

So many compliments! Fit wonderfully. Zipper took some work though but it came up. It has pockets! Love that this dress has pockets! Couldn't wear a regular bra bc of the back so i had to use adhesive bra cups. The material itches under the arm a bit but not bad. First experience with rtr and will be back for sure!
Elegant and sexy

I rented this to wear over the weekend and received tons of compliments.  Love the versatility of getting two pieces for a single rental and the underlying dress flutters beautifully in the breeze.  Plus the overall look was surprisingly flattering considering the cut and shape.
Great for spring or fall....I'm a 34DD/size 4-6 and the S fits perfect.  I wore a bralette underneath bc it is low-cut.  Wore with jeans and booties....cute for an 'everyday' outfit!

This was last-minute back-up dress picked online when my first choice wasn't going to arrive on time. Couldn't have been happier with this twist of fate! Reading the reviews also really helped cement my choice (based on similar body styles). Color is charcoal (not green) that turns iridescent as it transitions to champagne color at hem. Fabric weight is substantial, but I wasn't too hot/great if you run cold! 2R was perfect in length (did wear ~4" heels) and bust. I never felt like it was going to fall down during the night, built-in corset did wonders for structure/support. Pockets were nice (but I didn't really use them to hold lipstick, etc.). Length was perfect for walking, sitting, and eating (not a dancer...but I could've in this dress!).  Would totally rent again!

This dress is awesome for any time you want to show every inch and curve during a night on the town.  It would be perfect for Miami or Vegas, but definitely not appropriate for other cocktail settings in tamer cities.

review_summary: Nothing, I didn't wear the dress.
review_text: This is a beautiful gown ...if it fits. I was so excited to wear this to my friend's formal wedding, but was unable to because the straps were way too long. I don't have a short torso, but I do have a smaller frame (upper body) and I think this dress needs to be on someone who has pretty broad shoulders and/or no boobs. I tried to shorten the straps by pinning them down, but it didn't work. When I wore the straps the way that they were, most of my chest was showing. I don't have large boobs or anything, I am pretty standard (34B/C), but without a bra, they were definitely showing.

I wore this for date night, and it was really pretty. Be prepared because the dress is pretty heavy, but well worth it. This dress is low cut, so if you are also fuller chested, I recommend getting a push up bra to make your chest look as nice as possible. If you have a natural fuller chest, the low cut is not going to do sagging any favors because you will be on full display!  :|

It fit perfectly and the adjustable shoulder straps helped make sure that you had the right torso length when wearing it.  This was perfect for a day event in the sun and breathed nicely with the fabric.  I was a little worried that it would be too tight across my chest, but it fit really well and came in with a nice flattering waist.  The short length when standing was perfect - around mid-thigh, but as with most rompers when sitting it did get a little high up the leg, but nothing too risky

review_summary: I wore this dress to a wedding. It was classy and fun. This dress got uncountable compliments.
review_text: The dress fit me PERFECTLY. I'm 5'2" & was worried about the length but it looked great. I am too heavy & can never go without a bra. I was reluctant to believe other reviewers when they said one wasn't needed but the snug fit gave me phenominal support. It looked like I was wearing one. The fit of the dress is form fitting but gave me plenty of room to move in & the design was flattering & didn't bunch in the wrong places. I looked and felt beautiful, especially w/ all the genuine compliments I got all night!

review_summary: Got many compliments on the dress!
review_text: Warm for a winter event in the Midwest, but lots of sparkle and fun.  No cons!

review_summary: Dress was perfect for a Black Tie Optional Wedding!
review_text: This dress was great! I wore it to a Black Tie Optional Wedding. I received a TON of compliments on it and it was very comfortable. I am 5'3" and I probably could have done the 4P instead of the 4R. I had about 3 inch heels on and the back of the dress just barely touched the ground. But.. when I walked and there was a breeze it flowed behind me and looked amazing. I would definitely recommend this dress. It is great for any pear shape because the top was perfectly snug, and I didn't have to worry about the hip area fitting at all.  I will say the pictures I took did show a little darker than the dress shows on the website. But still loved it.
I liked this dress overall, but it was too short. It felt borderline inappropriate for a wedding.

I liked this dress a lot, I wore it to a group dinner and got a lot of compliments. It was perfect for the occasion because it wasn't too dressy but nicer than a pair of jeans. The detail was cute and it fit true to size. The elastic around the waist was a little strange but I got used to it.

review_summary: Got tons of compliments from men and women alike. A very pretty, classy, fun and sexy dress.
review_text: Fits fairly true to size. Since no petite sizes are available, the length of the skirt falls below the knees instead above the knee as shown in the photo on the model. Watch our for potential scratches from the pailettes. I had scratches on the back of my leg where the skirt ends and on my side, just underneath the armhole opening.

I loved this dress! I wore it out for a date night and it was perfect. I got so many compliments!  Not too tight in the hips and was comfortable even sitting down for a while.  The dress comes in two parts--a pull over white slip, and the lace dress that zips up.  You'll definitely want nude underwear and a nude bra for the white portion as it is somewhat sheer.

I loved this dress. The fabric felt really sexy. The slit was high but not too high and I felt really comfortable eating in it.  I didn't even need to wear a bra!  I wore this for a rehearsal dinner and it was perfect!

This dress wasn't my first, second, third, or even fourth dress choice, but due to issues with all of my other choices having issues, I had to settle with this dress, my fifth pick. But once, I put it on I realized this dress was actually perfect. Being full figured, finding a dress that is flattering can be hard, but this dress did just that and more. It was excellent quality.

review_summary: Lots of dress compliments, but it was a little stretched out.
review_text: Overall enjoyed the dress. the neck area felt a little stretched out. I am 5'7" and the regular size was a bit shorter than i wanted -- i wore very low pumps but you could see the shoes.  It was a fun dress to dance in and I got a lot of compliments. It looked great in photos.

review_summary: Loved this dress- perfect fabric weight and color for a fall wedding.
review_text: This dress was really comfortable and flattering! The thicker fabric was nice for a fall wedding and it was helpful that the straps are adjustable. The bust is generous so having adjustable straps really helped make sure that the dress was fitting where it should. On that note- I'm on the shorter side (5"3') so the hem of the size S dress hit mid-calf. I would definitely wear this again!

This jumpsuit is great!  I'm 5'9" and was concerned the "regular" would be too short but it wasn't.  I put a tank top underneath to make it appropriate for work.  It would look killer without the tank for an evening event!  Highly recommend.
I've rented quite a few outfits, some of them pretty luxurious, but this is my favorite. Super flattering, comfortable, an in a bold color to boot.

This dress could really fit any body type. It has a cute flair that is just fitted through the waist to give shape. The pale pink color was very subtle and sweet. 

One thing I will note, the dress is short. I could bend over safely, but I had to be very cautious of how. I am 5'8" and I think that is the max height for a family-friendly length. Taller than this and I would say it fits like a mini dress in length. On the plus side, you can wear full coverage undergarments since the dress is not fitted from the hips down.  Lastly, the bow on the back is difficult to tie neatly due to the thickness of the material.

review_summary: Beautiful dress.  Bride even complemented me on the dress!!
review_text: Fit great.  Snug but comfortable.  Nice length as well.  Just above the knees.
Very form fitting but also very comfortable. One of the most flattering dresses that I've ever worn.
Comfortable, perfect for holiday party! Relaxed in the tummy, good for pear shapes.

review_summary: Pretty, flattering, and easy to coordinate with a variety of accessories.
review_text: Very flattering on short, curvy figure.  Cute zipper detail on the back! Wore to a holiday cocktail party.

I wore this dress while 27 weeks pregnant. I was a little bummed that RTR didn't actually have maternity dresses under the maternity section, so I went ahead and found a dress that was baggy enough to fit. It was a little loose on the shoulders but the amaller size was too small on my waist. Overall, I was pretty happy with the rental and I got a few compliments alone on the beautiful fuschia color of this dress!

I ordered this dress as a back up to another and I was glad the original worked.  Although this dress is lovely, it definitely looks better on someone slimmer.  I thought that all the ruching would help to "hide" flaws but I felt that there was too much of it thus causing an emphasis on the tummy area.  Also, the sequins were very itchy under my arms even when I was trying it on so I couldn't imagine wearing it for an entire evening of dancing although if you are someone who doesn't have "extra padding" under your arms like I do, you might be fine!  Now if I lost that 50 lbs that I have been wanting to, I might try it again...lol

Little bit wrinkly out the gate, I tried to iron, but it got wrinkly again in the bag. I didn't care. Look was a 70's floral dreamboat, it was just right for a wedding at a summer camp. I danced my ass off in this thing. So comfortable and easy, and somehow also glam.

review_summary: Flattering and comfortable - the perfect wedding guest dress.
review_text: I was nervous about picking a dress since I still have some post baby problem areas. I wanted something flattering, but not too tight in the mid-section. This dress was PERFECT! The material is thick, but has a little stretch to it. It falls perfectly over the belly area - not too tight. The V neck is deeper than it appears on the model - especially if you're larger chested. Overall this was a feminine yet sexy dress that I would  highly recommend.
Comfortable, not pulling at it or adjusting it at all through the night. Very flattering. Beautiful color.
Pretty top, great color. I'm not usually one for ruffles but this was classy!

review_summary: A red dress is always a showstopper!
review_text: This dress was incredible. Compliments all night and one of my most liked instagrams :). The color commands attention, and it fit like a glove. If you have a bigger bust, I reco a bigger size - otherwise fits perfectly!

review_summary: I wore this dress for Mardi Gras ball, and it was the perfect combination of fun and elegance.
review_text: This dress fit mostly true to size, although it was about half an inch longer than I would've preferred. Although, at 5'2, that's not uncommon.
I wore this to my company's holiday party and I got lots of compliments. The cut and fabric are very flattering, and the color is beautiful. I highly recommend this dress!
I wore this two days in a row lol. Loved the fit and style.

I felt great in this dress.  It wasn't tight, but it hung really well.  Reviews are correct--it is slightly short (I wore with 2 inch heels and that's definitely the highest heel I could have worn).  I had to iron the sleeves and hem to have the lace lay correctly.  The color was beautiful, I got a bunch of compliments on the dress.

review_summary: Perfect for a night out in Vegas!
review_text: I love this skirt! It had the right amount of sparkle without looking cheap or over the top. The material is heavy and well made and has a bit of stretch so it's flattering on any figure! I received many compliments throughout  the evening and would highly recommend.

The cutest romper for any summertime event! This style runs true to size with a little bit of stretch in the fabric. Go one size up for back up. The overall fit is straight and fitted, but would work well for all body types and bust sizes. At 5'7, this falls pretty high on my thigh, making it a mini. Make this look pop by colorblocking with brightly colored accessories

As another reviewer said, "in a sea of black dresses, this dress stood out!"  I couldn't agree more.  I wore this for a not black tie but formal evening event.  It was beyond perfect.  The navy color and the tank style top kept the dress classy and traditional.  But, the pops of color at the bottom, pockets, and short skirt kept it fun and different.  Don't hesitate to rent this for your next event.  It was perfect and I was actually wishing that I had bought it as I feel you could wear it to many types of events.  The dress does run large...I got my usual size and then one size down as recommended.  But, actually I could have gone two sizes down. It was slightly big in the chest area (no surprise for me) and I had to wear my biggest push up bra, and there was still room.  Also, the bodice/waist area was on the bigger side too. Not so much that it looked bad, but it could have been more form fitting.  I loved the way the dress poufed out at the skirt and the pockets were fun.  So happy with this rent and I would completely rent again.

Knit dresses can sometimes feel and look cheap, but not this one. The design create a terrific hourglass shape and the length is a nice break from all the very short dresses I seem to keep renting. I would say the dress runs about a half size large - I don't think I would have liked a medium instead, but there is ample breathing room. If you are a small size 8 ordinarily, I would recommend the medium. 

The fabric can be a touch unforgiving, so if you are someone who cares about an errant bulge here and there, you'll want your shapewear, but the silhouette is quite flattering.

I rented this for a bridal shower while I was in my third trimester. The dress is pretty, light, and soft material. However, the straps were extremely long, so the dress fell below my chest. With all the ruffles on the top, it was too hard to try to tack up and any adjustments made the top awkward. I wanted to rent the 40, but it wasn't available, maybe this would have fixed the problem.

review_summary: Beautiful dress, I received many compliments
review_text: The dress runs big. Im currently a 34DD and the chest part slouched and I had to keep adjusting all day. I should've ordered the 4 instead of the 6.

This dress was gorgeous! I got so many compliments on it, and was told by multiple people that I was the best dressed at the event. I would say that it runs large, as I normally wear a size 6 and I felt that the size 4 that I ended up wearing was still a little loose.

review_summary: Overall great dress but runs large. Loved the racerback and detail on the bottom of the skirt.
review_text: This dress does run large. I am normally a size 12 no question. I am glad I got the backup in a size 10 but truthfully could have used a size 8. I have a fairly large chest and the top was huge. I used some clothing tape to keep it from gapping. Otherwise, the dress was super comfy and let me dance the night away. Would recommend this dress just size down!!! This was also my first time using rent the runway and I really enjoyed it.

I rented this dress as part of an Unlimited membership to bring on a trip to Miami and California. The material felt a little cheap, but like everyone's photos show it is cute on. I found it a little long for my 5'2" height and there's definitely a low cut on top so it's hard to wear any kind of bra with it. I ended up only wearing it once with a jean jacket.
Loose flowy top. Very pretty details! I wore with jeans to brunch. Could definitely wear to work if you work in a not super formal setting.

This skirt is lovely and fun, but it runs quite large.  I ordered a 4 and it was a good 2 inches too big in the waist.  Even with thick tights and a shirt tucked in it still sat down on my hips.  Otherwise, it is a charming pattern and cut.  The fabric is quite lightweight, so it will work for warmer months as well.

Loved this dress. First photo shows the deep v-neck in the front. Be prepared to show cleavage. Second photo shows overall style, flirty skirt, flattering cut around v-neck. Third photo shows length. Material is a bit heavier (almost spongy, no wrinkles after sitting). Comfortable to walk, sit, eat and dance in. I have a very large chest, so I tend to get my "size" and backup in larger size. I was able to wear my regular size in this dress with it still being roomy.

Super cute dress, but runs really big. I usually wear a 2 and the 2 was huge -- the 0 was even slightly big. I used lots of fashion tape to keep the top in place + prevent any wardrobe malfunctions! Got lots of compliments and it was super comfortable all night. LOTS of fun to dance in too -- the skirt poofs out and is a great twirling dress. Best part... it has pockets, so I didn't need a purse!

I ordered the 4 and 8 (as my actualy size 6 was not available). I wore the 8 which was a bit baggy in the bodice (elastic waist) but it worked as I wore it under an olive green "cargo" jacket. It was the perfect casual day to night outfit for my visit to Asheville, NC which is more of a casual beer town. The material was thin but nice quality. I found the rental very pricy (got it free due to an error on my previous order) and would never rent nor even buy this at full price... this is definitely a dress running on the designer name for the price. I did not get a photo, sadly.
I returned and did not wear this coat.  A very pretty color but the fit was a disappointment.
Feminine, soft, beautiful and comfortable. Has pockets, too. No Spanx needed. What more could a girl ask for?
Loved the cape and shoulder cap. Ran large in the waist area and pant length extended well beyond ankle. Odd fit around the hip and crotch area but not a big issue when paired with heels.

review_summary: Looked good on the hanger, but looked huge on my body - so, I was unable to use.
review_text: Big overall... shoulders, width and length seem 2 sizes bigger than the size on the label. Won't be able to wear this one, unfortunately.

This was my first choice rental for a wedding, but it looked awful on me. I guess I'm in the minority here because I ordered my regular size (4) and 6 as a backup as most indicated that the dress runs small. I was basically swimming in the dress (super baggy in the chest and gaping near my waist) and it hit me at an awkward length. I wanted to love this dress, but it really wasn't for me at all.

I am obsessed with this dress. It's not what I would normally go for, but I went out of my comfort zone and it was amazing. The fabric is so beautiful. It is high quality and thick, but lightweight. The open feel of the dress kept me cool in the middle of New Orleans summer. Definitely size down, and expect for it to be a roomy dress.
Overall the fit is great and flattering - one note if you do not have a large chest the top portion will be very loose and kind of bulky

review_summary: Wore this dress to my birthday party and received a million compliments!
review_text: This is a sexy/classy/edgy dress that got loads of attention and compliments.  I was able to wear a backless bustier underneath it, which was great because it is definitely LARGE in the chest area.  As someone with a 32DD chest, those are words I usually never have to say, but this dress was definitely gaping a bit at the chest, thus the 4 star rating.  Otherwise, lovely!

review_summary: This dress was beautiful, but very matronly. I was unable to wear it because it was too big.
review_text: Large fit.

As other reviewers warned, it is a very baggy, loose fit.  I wrapped the ties at the back fully around my waist and tied it off at the front to create some shape in the waist.  It's cute and comfortable and I loved the colors and pattern.

review_summary: Good dress, but better for a different body type
review_text:
I rented this for the High Holidays. Good quality material and looked sharp with a bolero. I'd read reviews that said to size down and that is no joke. I wear a 4 but tried on the backup size 2 first--and it was too big. I had to belt it, but then it bunched up under the belt (you can't see from the photo because I pulled the bunched up area to the back). This is a very forgiving silhouette and I would highly recommend this dress for someone looking to hide any problem areas below the waist. 
If you are a "straight and narrow" and athletic body type this dress isn't for you. Perhaps if you size down twice and don't have a large chest (I'm a 34C and it fit fine on top; it was the bottom that was the issue).

Fit a little loose because I am between sizes 
But I love the dress

review_summary: Black Tie event and I felt like the belle of the ball!
review_text: I normally wear a size 2. My last RTR dress was a 2L. All the reviews mentioned how the dress ran large so I chose a 0L as a back up. Since the gown is bottom heavy, the 2L fit a bit loose because the back is open. The 0L was perfect though, a bit snug but I didn't have to wear a bra (just nippies). The pockets were perfect. And the deep purple color was gorgeous. I received so many compliments. I wore pumps that were about 2-3 inches high and it was still floor length. I wanted to keep this dress!
This dress runs large.  It is a heavy fabric love the design.  compliments all day!  Forgot to take a picture! Perfect for work alone, with a chunky necklace , jacket or black hose.

review_summary: Great Dress, but not for everyday!
review_text: This dress was cute! Fit large but I like the room. I rented this to wear to work, but am returning it after one wear. The fabric shows wrinkles SUPER quickly, after sitting at my desk for three hours I was a wrinkle monster. This dress would be better for special occasion wear

review_summary: crochet pattern in the front was not flattering. three are large diamonds on the front.
review_text: silhouette was cute with a high low hemline

review_summary: Beautiful, quality dress. But runs large.
review_text: I received so many compliments on the dress. It was incredibly comforts and looked great. It’s heavy material and lined. It definitely runs large, and it ended up being more tent-like that I wanted. I’d definitely recommend getting the size down as backup

Fun jacket perfect for everyday wear! This jacket is great because it can be dressed up or down. It does run a little large so I would size down in this. There is no stretch to this fabric but does not cling to you - there is comfortable room to breathe. I would add a fun statement necklace when wearing this!

I loved it, I want to buy this one.  People were stopping me on the street to give compliments.  The black straps are a bit large, I kept having to pull the top down so the straps to hang out there against the air.

I have a straight / athletic body and typically wear a size 4/6 in dresses.  I ended up in the 2 and still found it to be too big / poofy in the front, though a bit tight in the arms.  The distance between the buttons isn't ideal as no matter your chest size, they will gape slightly.  One definitely needs a belt to add shape.  I had to wear flats to make it a graceful length which wasn't as fun, but it was comfortable.
I wore this for a day of wine tasting, and it was great. Note that the dress runs huge - I'm either a 4 or 6, depending on the dress, and I wore the 2 with room to spare.
This is a relaxed fit sweater
Wore this to my husband's graduation and it did not disappoint. The fit was comfortable, even after wearing the smallest possible size. It hides midsection flaws well. Lot's of compliments!

This was a gorgeous dress and I really loved it, but it was a little large in the top. The arm holes were so big that my bra kept showing. This was surprising because usually I need to go up a size for the top to fit. I would definitely rent this dress again but would go down a size.
