I loved this dress. The color online dosn't do it justice. It is more maroon than red. The lace detail is so feminine and pretty. It has a great modern Victorian vibe or maybe even gothic feel. I am large chested and the size 12 fit comfortably and hid tummy lumps. I will definitely rent again for the Holiday season.

I absolutely loved this dress. It was very hard to move my arms, but I felt so sexy and elegant without being over the top. The fabric has a lot of give and it was a little big, so I felt a little like it was going to fall off all night. I would have been more comfortable in the 10, but it worked anyway. Really just a stunning dress.
The dress fit great!  It was very low cut, so I had to keep my back straight, but that's not a bad thing!  I am 5'3" and the regular length was perfect with 3 inch heels.

review_summary: Unfortunately, this dress was way too long for me to wear it on my birthday.
review_text: I'm 5'1 and it hit below my knees. It's a pretty dress but I had to send it back.
The dress is very boxy and runs large.

review_summary: Very comfortable for an outdoor garden wedding.
review_text: I usually wear either an 8 or 10, the 8 fit more comfortable with still some room to spare. I liked that you can adjust the belt and create your own waistline. Very comfortable to wear for an outdoor wedding and nicely lined so the dress was not sheer.
Fit is large and coat is boxy. One of the unlimited rental, I wore this everyday on vacation and it was warm enough for fall temps and can be worn causally or dressed up.

Rented this dress for NYE and loved it. I ordered a small, my typical size (size 4/ 27 waist) and it fit well. I am 5’8, so the higher cut side of the dress came up quite high when I raised my arms but it still worked out perfectly. Would recommend!
Unique stitching and very nice feel on the silk. It was baggy under the arms so I did not wear it, but would rent again in a smaller size.

review_summary: I returned it without wearing it, very loose in the chest and I am 34C. Unflattering.
review_text: Did not fit!

review_summary: Amazing dress, DVF at her best
review_text: I love DVF dresses, but this dress was literal perfection. It runs a bit big (I tend to size down in her dresses, so I would get an 8/10 instead of a 12 or a M instead of a L), but sits so perfectly and flowy. Great for work or a casual event. I want to rent this again and again!

This dress is more for a curvy large chest body type. I'm a borderline 6/8 in dresses and this dress runs large - if you're in between sizes - size down. I thought the dress was more of a "bodycon" style - really stretchy and form fitting - it is not. Which isn't a bad thing, just know that if that's what you're looking for. The top is definitely made for a bustier gal - I was not able to wear the dress because the top would of definitely fell down if I danced too much!! The dress would be very flattering on another body type though. It didn't look as expensive as I thought it would either.

review_summary: It was a beautiful color of red!
review_text: The last time I used RTR, I wore a size 4 and I weighed 106 lbs. I weighed 8 pounds more this time, but wore my back up Size 2 and it still felt too big. So, definitely size down when ordering. That part aside, it was still a really pretty dress and I felt good in it. I'd give it 5 stars if it fit better.

Love this dress! It's so stretchy and soft and pulls on overhead. I'm petite and worried the sleeves would be too long, but they go just to meat of my thumb. I'm not sure how forgiving the material would be for curvier ladies as it's pretty thin, but I loved it. I'm 5'2" and usually wear a 0/2P and this goes just above my knees.
The arms were a little big and long. I had to keep pushing them up but the cuff was also large so they wouldn't stay. Great quality jacket but will order a size small next time.

review_summary: Cute top to mix up your wardrobe
review_text: I received top new with tags, which was a nice bonus. It has a pretty deep V cut in front, which is typical of wrap tops, so I wore a tank beneath it. I really like this top and may rent it again or possibly buy it. It runs a bit large, so I may try the XS. This would be a cute top to wear to a yoga class (a non-sweat inducing class) and then go out afterwards. It could also be suitable for work.
Very soft and good length.  I wore it un-zipped.  Belt is sewn in so that can't be removed.

This dress was perfect for an evening summer wedding. I was hesitant at first with some of the reviews mentioning the top running a bit large. The straps in the back could have been a little shorter/tighter and you definitely need to have something to help fill out the top, but I still rate this 5 stars. Super comfortable and easy to dance in all night.

review_summary: Can be dress up, but I wore as is to work. It's  a fun flouncy skirt. Order two sizes down.
review_text: It is well made.  The skirt portion runs large.  Order two size down.....really.

review_summary: Cute, comfy dress for work.  Beware of wrinkles (and gaps)!
review_text: First, forgive the work bathroom selfie.  I am the worst about remembering to take pictures in the cute things I rent.  I got an email before my order shipped letting me know the belt for this dress hadn't been returned, but decided to have them send it anyway.  The dress arrived a bit wrinkled at the bottom of the skirt, but I wore it to work anyway.  I added a white shrug, and burgundy belt and Tieks, as well as a nude tank underneath.  I realized shortly after getting to work that the buttons on the skirt gaped when I sat down.  I promptly covered up with a blanket while sitting at my desk and made a mental note to put on a slip when I went home for lunch.  On the way back to the office, I got stuck in a downpour and got soaked, which did not help with the already growing wrinkle issue.  Overall, the dress was really cute, but may or may not be one I would rent again.  Oh, one major upside I almost forgot: it does have pockets!!

This dress was a little tight in the rib cage but loose in the shoulders.  I generally wear a 2 or 4 and there was no way I could have fit in the 4 as a petite person.  The layers on the skirt can get a little stuck to each other but it didn't really cause me any problems.  The dress was easy to wear and I got lots of compliments.

review_summary: Adorable, airy, flattering dress- tons of compliments!
review_text: Great dress- I usually wear a size 4 and an XS fit (although was on the small/short side). I wore it for graduation under a gown and it was light enough so that I wasn't uncomfortable.
Runs very large

This dress was really disappointing. I was looking forward to having a fun dress to wear to my birthday dinner, but was saddened the second I zipped this up. The top runs a size too large, leaving gaps of loose fabric along the bust/arms. Because of the cut of the back, I didn't wear a bra and with the gaps I was constantly fiddling with the top, scared I was flashing everyone in the restaurant. The skirt portion is pretty and also fit a little large, but the sizing didn't make it look completely ill-fitting, just looser than expected...it ended up being the dress' only good part. The color and cut detail comes across as just meh in real life.

review_summary: So many compliments on this dress! Classy and COMFY.
review_text: This ran a bit large for me. To get a truly fitted look I had to size down from my usual size 2. That said, it fit like a glove when I did. It's a thick fabric. So great for fall/winter weddings. It's super comfortable too!
Got lots of compliments on this but had to wear a blazer over top because it had a weird slit in the back area which made it NSFW.   Otherwise, great dress and enjoyed wearing it.

I liked this dress a lot, but don't know if I would rent again only because it was so large. It looked nice on, but the v-neck probably showed more than it should have and the arm holes were also large. These were more of an issue because I wore this to work. With all that being said, it was super comfortable and it is a fantastic light weight material for a hot summer day.

review_summary: Gorgeous, comfortable dress! Great for cocktail party or wedding events
review_text: This was a beautiful gown!!! I received compliments galore. Comfortable, with pockets (always a selling point for me). Pictures do not do this dress justice. Truly beautiful! Runs a bit large. I could have worn a size 12 and typically wear 14-16 in formal dresses. Very pleased!

review_summary: sexy and fabulous all while be classic and chic
review_text: holding on to this one.  it just may have to find a hanger in my closet.  the fabric makes this top very high end, lays nicely and if in winter states it is perfect for the weather without boiling in it when indoors.  i felt confident and hip at a black the black tie event but can vision wearing this dressed down as well.  love the sleeves and the full zipper in back.

review_summary: Pretty dress - but a bit wrinkly and large!
review_text: I normally wear a 2, but I wish I had gotten a 0; it was just a bit too baggy, and because it's so heavy, two sided tape won't do the trick. But , the dress itself is really pretty! Perfect for an evening wedding in the summer, as it has a bit of a nautical vibe to it.

This dress was perfect for a September wedding!  I wore the medium since the size small was not available.  This dress runs large but it was manageable for the evening. The dress is well made and extremely comfortable!  I added a fancy necklace and earrings to dress it up a bit.  I highly recommend!
Its nice sweater but runs little larger than what I thought. If you are looking for something cozy, this is perfect sweater for you.

review_summary: Beautiful design, but needs a belt to cinch in the waist.
review_text: Can be dressed up or down with heels or a pair of flats. I paired mine with wedges and chunky earrings.

Will buy this! Such a beautiful dress and the color is perfect. I don't think I will wear the choker for personal looks but the length and coverage blends well with the boho sexy. May go down a size before I put in the credit card but this is going to be in my closet long term.

review_summary: Great dress, but large in the bust, dips low had to use safety pin.
review_text: Good fit overall, except chest.

review_summary: The dress was a huge hit! Tons of compliments!
review_text: This dress was incredibly comfortable. I was surprised to fit into a 0 so it may run a little big.
this top was super cute and feminine - I really wanted it to work with distressed jeans and heels but unfortunately, the straps are not adjustable and they kept falling off of my shoulder

This is a great dress. Normally I wear a size 8 (46), but I ended up wearing the 44. It has great stretch. I am about 5' 2" 135 hourglass shape, with larger breasts (32DDD), and I did NOT wear a bra with this. I couldn't believe it. Everyone said I looked stunning and I felt great. The dress has a lot of stretch and hides the tum area, which is a definite added plus. This was my back-up dress and I do not regret wearing it.

review_summary: Definitely size down on this one
review_text: This looked cute on the model, but not on me. Very boxy. Probably should have sized down. Comfortable material, quality piece.

review_summary: Great Dress for a fall wedding!
review_text: As many say, this dress runs LARGE.  Size down! But I loved it and got so many compliments.  I would love to own this dress.

review_summary: Deep red dress. High quality material.
review_text: I ordered a much larger size for 35 week pregnancy bump. This made the top part just a little too large as the sleeves kept falling down. I probably should have used some fashion tape. Overall, I enjoyed this piece and received many compliments. It was a deeper red than I was expecting.

review_summary: Comfy and cute for brunch and church
review_text: Loved the fit of this dress (as I love all Tibi).  The top was a little big, but no big deal with a sticky bra on! Very cute little rose gold accents, open back, and lovely length (mid-calf, I'm 5'10").  Ill definitely be renting again!

review_summary: The dress was beautiful, but being in between sizes I would have sized down to a 10 for this one.
review_text: Beautiful dress- will require a low back and adjustable strap bra for the perfect fit!

The fabric and design of the dress is very elegant and classy, received many compliments. I'm 5'4" and the regular length was perfect using heels. My waist is around 27-28 inches and size 6 was a bit loose, a size 4R would have fitted much better. Because of the cleavage I had to wear self additive bra cups that I bought here at RTR, nothing uncomfortable. The opening in the bottom side is gorgeous and is not very revealing (it goes up to the knee). Very recommended.

I wore this for a bachelorette party and it was a more conservative black night option. I rented a 6, but normally wear a 10. I could even wear a bra with this dress so you know it wasn't tight. The length was mid-thigh (5'6") and the material was fairly thick. I'd advise renting a size or two down!
So comfortable and easy to wear, just wish it wasn't so expensive for what it is! It is big and hangs loose so if you prefer a more form fitting or revealing style this isn't for you.

model is 5'10 so when i wore this dress it was an awkward length. it does accentuate shoulder if you have an athletic build
half way down my knee, will not rent again

review_summary: I wore this dress to an award ceremony.
review_text: This dress was a little hard to zip up. Usually I wear an 8 but I fit in the 6 better. The pockets were very handy! This dress was light and comfortable, and garnered many compliments. I had originally requested the blue and black, but got the red and black sent to me (my second choice).

review_summary: I received so many compliments on this dress.  Wore it out for Easter dinner.
review_text: Definitely order a size down.  I ordered the 2, with a 0 as the backup.  I ended up wearing the 0 and it fit me perfectly.

review_summary: This dress looked amazing next to my husband in his "blues", without being over the top!!
review_text: I looked online at the designer's "size guide" and it was pretty close to how the dress fit.  I ordered a 6R and I typically wear a 4.  I probably could have worn the 4R, but the 6 allowed for a little more comfort.  The top portion of the dress was sized larger than stated, but it wasn't all that noticeable due to the neckline cut and the sparkles :)

I rented this dress for a fancy sushi dinner during a tropical vacation. It was extremely comfortable and light. The length made it perfect for the evening, when it cooled down a bit, and the pattern was fabulous. The colors are definitely brighter than they appear online - which was a plus for me. I paired with tan sandals. Definitely recommend! I could see wearing this to the beach as well.

I wore this for my sister's bridal shower and I got a ton of compliments. This dress is super comfortable and the high-low is a little more pronounced... but I liked it a  lot! Usually because of my legs high-low dresses don't look good on me but this really worked. I would definitely rent again!

The dress fit great and was perfect for a fall wedding. Additional size should be sized down as it does run large. Great for pear shape as it's more fitted up top but nice and roomy for hips. Length was good for wedding; not too long not too short.

Free People dresses always seem to run big, and this dress does too. I am usually a medium but a small fit perfect. Only downside is the extra long length of the sleeves! Wore this with black tights and black over the knee boots for family pictures. Love it!!

review_summary: Great dress for a fall wedding
review_text: This dress is truly unique. Very comfortable and flowy with beautiful lace detail. It really isn't form-fitting, I put a belt around my waist to create a better fit. Overall loved it, free people never disappoints!

Wore this dress with some Sottsass-inspired earrings and  skinny cat-eye sunglasses. Felt so very modern Memphis Milano. Got tons of compliments from both sexes. Ended up buying it because it was THAT good. It was a smidge long (nothing a tailor can't fix) but petite renters beware. Also, wrinkles easier than I'd like but I also feel it hides the wrinkles well.

Like other renters, I also belted this dress to make it really pop. I do think if you have bigger hips like I do, the dress does take a nice, natural shape that flatters. I could see how on less curvy body types that this would hang like a sack. Regardless, I decided to belt it for maximum adorable impact -- also raising the hem a touch. I also wore with my over the knee black boots and hot pink Kate Spade purse. Two people separately told me I looked like Elle Woods so I think that was a big win all around. I'll definitely wear again! (and take a photo next time!)
It is stunning, runs large, so have your back up a size smaller.  Step in.  I was stunning in the dress.
This dress was fine for a casual daytime dress, but I found that it ran large and overall just wasn't that flattering.

Great option for a fall dress for work and it can also be worn in winter with tights. The picture shows the dress as blue but it is more of a purple tone in person. The style can be work with a regular bra and does not need Spanx, the style runs large so be sure to size down for your backup size. The fabric has a lot of stretch and I had comfortable room in the bust and hips. The hemline fell around my knee/mid thigh. I would recommend this style for women with these body types: Apple, Hourglass, Athletic, Pear, Petite, Straight & Narrow, Full Bust
Beautiful dress, I have rented several dresses by this designer and loved the material and style.  This one was just too big. I would need to size down considerably.  Also it was quite low cut...

Unfortunately, I didn't get a great floor length pic, but I recommend sizing down. The size medium I received was missing some beading at the top and was enormous. The small also ran a little large and I was thinking I could have gotten away with an XS. It was also clear this dress was meant for someone with larger breasts because there was some gaping near the armpits even after tightening the straps and adding dress tape. Still this was an extremely comfortable, pretty dress for a more casual setting. It was perfect length for flats or sandals (I'm 5'8").

Rented for Gatsby themed birthday party. The dress is beautiful and heavy, which felt great. Does not hug the body too tight. Almost felt a bit too loose on me in the mid section. May just be my own oversight, as I fluctuate between a 2/4. The plunging neckline is very sexy, but could not wear a bra. Does not itch at all!! Simple yet elegant. I gave it 4 starts, only because it was a little loose on me, bu otherwise a really cute and comfortable party dress.
I loved this casual combo.  It runs large so I will rent again but a size smaller.  Could wear the pieces separately as well.
